items.text: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield did not practice today due to a foot injury.
items.why: Schefter report; Bowles says progress, decide Friday
items.implication: Jalon Daniels likely starter vs DET if sits; impacts Bucky Irving/Egbuka/Godwin usage
items.opportunity: Run-heavy script or backup QB volatility for WRs/RBs

items.text: Andy Reid on Kenneth Walker III: sore groin getting better but 'don't want to do something stupid.' Signs point to another week of Emmett Johnson with Chiefs heavy favorites and Thanksgiving game next.
items.why: Reid comments and Schefter analysis; no rush with backup producing
items.implication: High chance sits Week 11 vs ARI; monitor Thu/Fri practice
items.opportunity: Full backfield workload for backup if OUT

items.text: FULL CHUB(A) FOR MR. HUBBARD! Chuba Hubbard is my RB6 in rest-of-season rankings.
items.implication: Strong start/sit and trade value boost

items.text: No IR for Jordan Addison per coach Kevin O’Connell after thumb surgery. Decision subject to change but team believes return before Week 15 possible.
items.implication: Stash; Jefferson/others elevated targets short-term with Cousins
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Jefferson and other Vikes WRs

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) expected back for Sunday vs Steelers per HC Nick Sirianni. Both out since Week 6.
items.implication: Smith strong volume bet despite Milton QB; Wicks lower
items.opportunity: Smith WR2/3 upside with full practice week

items.text: Agree with Reid that playing Ken Walker at less than 100% would be stupid. Chiefs 15.5-pt favorites vs Beck Cardinals; huge game at BUF Week 12.
items.implication: Do not force Walker back; prioritize health for tougher matchups

items.text: Eagles HC Nick Sirianni said QB Joe Milton will start Sunday vs. the Steelers.
items.implication: Hurts out; impacts all Eagles skill (Smith/Wicks return helps)

items.text: In first game with Kirk Cousins, Vikings set a season-high in Pass Rate Over Expectation. Clear Kevin O'Connell wants to throw a lot. Jefferson routes near 100%.
items.why: PROE spike and route data with Cousins
items.implication: Jefferson elite WR1 boost; pass-heavy offense ROS
items.opportunity: High target/route share for Jefferson and Vikes pass catchers

items.text: Brock Bowers not believed to have major ankle injury, more day-to-day. Coach called it significant but not as bad as thought; DNP Wed possible, doesn't need practice to play.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Michael Mayer elevated if limited/out vs DEN
items.opportunity: Mayer TE stream if Bowers sits

items.text: I am CLOSING IT OUT on Jaylen Waddle. The target share is nice. The production is not.
Lions placed EDGE Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve and activated S Kerby Joseph from Reserve/PUP.
items.implication: Lions defense impact; Joseph boosts secondary

items.text: Mike Evans (Achilles) will not practice Wednesday but Shanahan hopeful he practices tomorrow and has chance vs Vikings in Mexico City.
items.implication: Long shot for Week 11; Deebo/others handle load

items.text: Coach Aaron Glenn said Geno Smith will be limited during today’s practice. Tests showed nothing major on ankle/head injuries.
items.why: Glenn and prior Rapoport tests clear
items.implication: Likely plays vs LAC; monitor for Jets offense

items.text: Week 11 Waiver Wire from @notJDaigle: FAAB Guidance, Drop List, Injury Report, Streaming Options.
items.implication: Key adds amid byes and injuries
